senses.def: an earthquake
senses.ex: The quake destroyed hundreds of homes in the region.
senses.exPt: O terremoto destruiu centenas de casas na região.

senses.def: having passed the exams or training needed for a job
senses.ex: She's a qualified nurse with ten years' experience.
senses.exPt: Ela é uma enfermeira qualificada com dez anos de experiência.

senses.def: to win a place in the next part of a competition
senses.ex: Our team qualified for the final last night.
senses.exPt: Nosso time se classificou para a final ontem à noite.

senses.def: to have the right to have or do something
senses.ex: Students qualify for a discount on train tickets.
senses.exPt: Estudantes têm direito a desconto nas passagens de trem.

senses.def: to pass the exams needed for a profession
senses.ex: She qualified as a nurse two years ago.
senses.exPt: Ela se formou em enfermagem há dois anos.

senses.def: how good or bad something is
senses.ex: These shoes are expensive, but the quality is excellent.
senses.exPt: Estes sapatos são caros, mas a qualidade é excelente.

senses.def: an amount or number of something
senses.ex: They sell food in large quantities.
senses.exPt: Eles vendem comida em grandes quantidades.

senses.def: one of four equal parts of something
senses.ex: A quarter of the students live near the school.
senses.exPt: Um quarto dos alunos mora perto da escola.

senses.def: fifteen minutes before or after the hour
senses.ex: The class starts at a quarter past ten.
senses.exPt: A aula começa às dez e quinze.

senses.def: a woman who rules a country, or the wife of a king
senses.ex: The queen lives in a big palace.
senses.exPt: A rainha mora em um grande palácio.

senses.def: something you ask to get information
senses.ex: Can I ask you a question?
senses.exPt: Posso te fazer uma pergunta?

senses.def: a subject or problem that people discuss
senses.ex: It's only a question of time.
senses.exPt: É só uma questão de tempo.

senses.def: the mark ? written at the end of a question
senses.ex: Don't forget to put a question mark at the end.
senses.exPt: Não esqueça de colocar um ponto de interrogação no final.

senses.def: a list of written questions to get information from people
senses.ex: Please fill in this short questionnaire about our service.
senses.exPt: Por favor, preencha este breve questionário sobre o nosso atendimento.

senses.def: a line of people waiting for something
senses.ex: There was a long queue outside the cinema.
senses.exPt: Havia uma fila enorme na frente do cinema.

senses.def: done or happening in a short time
senses.ex: Can I ask you a quick question?
senses.exPt: Posso te fazer uma pergunta rápida?

senses.def: fast, or in a short time
senses.ex: She quickly finished her homework and went out.
senses.exPt: Ela terminou a lição rápido e saiu.

senses.def: making very little noise
senses.ex: The library is always very quiet.
senses.exPt: A biblioteca é sempre muito silenciosa.

senses.def: not talking much
senses.ex: You're very quiet today. Are you OK?
senses.exPt: Você está muito quieto hoje. Está tudo bem?

senses.def: calm, without many people or much activity
senses.ex: We live on a quiet street near the park.
senses.exPt: Moramos numa rua tranquila perto do parque.

senses.def: speaking with a soft voice
senses.ex: Please speak quietly in the library.
senses.exPt: Por favor, fale baixo na biblioteca.

senses.def: making very little noise
senses.ex: He quietly left the room.
senses.exPt: Ele saiu do quarto sem fazer barulho.

senses.def: to leave your job or school
senses.ex: She quit her job last month.
senses.exPt: Ela largou o emprego mês passado.

senses.def: to stop doing something, especially a bad habit
senses.ex: My dad quit smoking ten years ago.
senses.exPt: Meu pai parou de fumar há dez anos.

senses.def: more than a little, but not very
senses.ex: It's quite cold today, so wear a jacket.
senses.exPt: Está bastante frio hoje, então vista uma jaqueta.

senses.def: completely, often used with not
senses.ex: I'm not quite ready yet.
senses.exPt: Ainda não estou totalmente pronto.

senses.def: a game where people answer questions to test their knowledge
senses.ex: Let's do a quiz about animals!
senses.exPt: Vamos fazer um quiz sobre animais!

senses.def: a short test at school
senses.ex: We have a short maths quiz tomorrow.
senses.exPt: Temos um teste rápido de matemática amanhã.
